description: Subscribe to industry (NACE) monitoring: when any Norwegian company in the chosen industry triggers a monitored event (new announcement, status change such as bankruptcy/dissolution, or ownership update), Firmaradar delivers a webhook to your URL. Use list_nace_codes first to resolve the exact code. A subscription on a parent code matches all child codes. Restrict `events` (e.g. ['status_changed']) and use geographic/size filters to cut volume in large industries, or pick a digest `aggregation_mode`. One subscription per user and NACE code; a retry with the same callback replaces nonsecret settings and returns its ID; omitted secrets are retained, and an explicit empty value clears them. Another callback returns HTTP 409. Use PATCH for partial updates or DELETE before registering another flow. Requires a user whose plan has Firmaovervakning enabled. Call only when the user has asked to set up industry monitoring.

aggregation_mode.description: Delivery cadence. 'real_time' (default) posts each event immediately. 'hourly_digest' / 'daily_digest' batch events to reduce noise in high-volume industries.
aggregation_mode.title: Aggregation Mode

aktivert.description: Whether the subscription is active immediately (default true).
aktivert.title: Aktivert

bearer_token.description: Optional bearer token Firmaradar sends as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when calling your webhook URL, so your endpoint can authenticate the delivery. Stored encrypted.
bearer_token.title: Bearer Token

events.description: Which event types to deliver. Omit for all of them. Restrict to e.g. ['status_changed'] to receive only bankruptcy/dissolution signals and cut volume dramatically in large industries.
events.title: Events

fylke_filter.description: Optional geographic filter: only companies in these fylker (county numbers).
fylke_filter.title: Fylke Filter

kommune_filter.description: Optional geographic filter: only companies in these kommuner (4-digit kommunenummer).
kommune_filter.title: Kommune Filter

landsdel_filter.description: Optional geographic filter: only companies in these landsdeler.
landsdel_filter.title: Landsdel Filter

min_ansatte.description: Optional size filter: only companies with at least this many employees.
min_ansatte.title: Min Ansatte

min_omsetning_nok.description: Optional size filter: only companies with at least this much revenue (NOK).
min_omsetning_nok.title: Min Omsetning Nok

nace_code.description: The NACE code to monitor. Accepts a section letter ('G'), a group ('47'), or a more specific code ('47.110'). Resolve the exact code first with list_nace_codes if unsure. A subscription on a parent code also matches events in all child codes.
nace_code.title: Nace Code

url.description: HTTPS webhook URL that receives a POST for each matched event. Omit only if you intend to add it later via the portal.
url.title: Url

name: firmaradar_subscribe_nace
title: Subscribe to Industry Monitoring (NACE)
